description: Search AliExpress for products, prices and alternatives. Returned links are affiliate links.

country.description: Delivery country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Default: client location, else DE.

currency.description: Price currency. Default follows the delivery country.

max_price.description: Highest price in the selected currency.

min_price.description: Lowest price in the selected currency.

query.description: Original product request, in any language; used to check relevance.

required_title_terms.description: Literal words required in each title or variant options; put semantic requirements in query.

search_terms.description: 3–10 different English search phrases (2–5 words) for the same product: common name, synonyms, seller terms. Keep essential specifications. More phrases find more.

name: search_products

country.description: Delivery country for these prices; keep it for get_product_details.

hint.description: Suggested next step when the search is incomplete.

delivery_country.description: Country for this price, or unknown; delivery is not guaranteed.

delivery_days.description: Delivery time in days stated by AliExpress; an estimate, not a promise.

image.description: URL of the main product picture.

observed_at.description: Price observation time in Unix milliseconds; not a current price guarantee.

price.description: Price without shipping. See price_basis; if missing, it may be any variant, often the cheapest.

price_basis.description: listing: search listing variant (sku_id); sku: cheapest variant read matching requested options and price limits, with its own sku_id and shipping; bundle: requires other items in the order. Missing if no variant read was shown to match.

price_range.description: Price range of variants read, plus the search listing if incomplete; covers all variants only when variants_complete is true.

rating_pct.description: Share of positive ratings in percent.

shipping.description: Shipping cost to the delivery country, or "unknown"; do not estimate.

ships_from.description: Countries the variants read ship from.

variants_complete.description: True if every variant was read; otherwise other variants and prices may exist.

title: Search products
